<!-- pr-reviewer: d3316eb4fd6c92b9b2c6e5d226c4a13decc467b1 -->
**Review of #682 (head d3316eb4) - verdict: merge-ready (docs/process only, no build).**

Checked against AGENTS.md and the diff:
1. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is added (value 1) and tracked; `git check-ignore` reports it is not ignored, so the `!/.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` negation after `/.claude/*` works.
2. The `git checkout upstream/main -- ...` list (AGENTS.md fork sub-bullet) matches #681's body exactly: AGENTS.md, .claude/agents, .claude/skills, .claude/PROCESS_VERSION, scripts/gate.ps1, scripts/gate.sh. The process-file list in the new rule and in review-prs 2d matches too.
3. Stated as an explicit exception ("This is the one exception to 'sync only to a cut tag'"), not a contradiction. Non-blocking nit: the preceding sentence "never into the fork's main" is overridden for process files; the exception wording covers it.
4. Cut step 2 reads correctly; the `docs: X.Y.Z release notes; changelog` commit text is intact (still split across the line as before). The dash-aside is a little clumsy; not a blocker.
5. PR-reviewer.md (bump check) and review-prs SKILL.md 2d agree with AGENTS.md on the file list, the missing-bump = requested change rule, and who posts the #681 comment on merge.
6. Five files, all process-related, no unrelated changes. No closing keywords in the PR title or body (the only "Fixes #N" hit is quoted text inside PR-reviewer.md's diff).

Follow-up at merge (not a blocker): #681 has 0 comments, so the merging session should post the `PROCESS_VERSION 1` announcement there.

Changelog: none (docs/process only). Not pushed or merged by the reviewer.

<!-- review-cost: measured -->
**Estimated agent cost:** ~$0.01 (59k tokens, measured)

| Run | Model | Tokens | Est. cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| review | Haiku 5.5 | 59k | ~$0.01 |

Blended upper estimate: 90 % input / 10 % output at list price (Opus 5.5 ~$5.60/M, Sonnet 5.5 ~$2.80/M, Haiku 5.5 ~$0.14/M). Cache reads make the real cost lower; main-session coordination isn't counted.
Covers the agent runs dispatched from the maintainer's session; a contributor's own authoring cost isn't visible and isn't included.
